item.title: WATCH: Illegal street racing 'takeover' explodes as hundreds swarm streets and suspects bolt
item.summary: Police say 18 people were arrested and firearms recovered after an illegal street racing takeover drew 200 to an Atlanta intersection Sunday.

item.title: Daughter of missing American in Bahamas says Brian Hooker using mother's illness as 'excuse' to leave country
item.summary: The daughter of an American woman missing in the Bahamas accuses stepfather Brian Hooker of using his mother's illness as an excuse to leave the country.

item.title: Garret Anderson, who helped lead Angels to their lone World Series title, dead at 53
item.summary: Garret Anderson, a three-time All-Star and key player in the Los Angeles Angels' 2002 World Series title, has died at 53, the Los Angeles Angels announced.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] White House meets AI firm Anthropic amid political tensions, Pentagon dispute
item.summary: Trump administration reconsiders Anthropic ban as CEO meets White House officials to discuss Mythos Preview, a powerful new AI cybersecurity model.

item.title: 1 million bees swarm highway after crash shuts down interstate ramp for hours
item.summary: A truck carrying 1 million bees crashed on Interstate 40 in Knoxville, Tennessee, closing part of the highway as beekeepers scrambled to contain them.

item.title: White House reviewing cases of missing, dead scientists for possible links as 11th person identified
item.summary: The White House says it is working with the FBI to review cases of American scientists who have gone missing or died in recent years in a growing list.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Ex-USWNT star Megan Rapinoe and WNBA great Sue Bird announce shocking split after 10 years
item.summary: WNBA legend Sue Bird and soccer star Megan Rapinoe announced they have split after 10 years, sharing the news in a joint statement on Friday.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Video shows teen snatched at bus stop – but victim slips SOS at gas station to escape repeat offender suspect
item.summary: A 16-year-old Michigan student was allegedly abducted at gunpoint while waiting for her school bus by a man charged as a three-time habitual offender.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Utah leaders launch probe into Supreme Court justice over alleged relationship with redistricting lawyer
item.summary: Utah officials ordered a probe into Supreme Court Justice Diana Hagen over alleged ties to an attorney involved in a key redistricting case ruling.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Wisconsin sheriff explains why he's suing for $1M after woman allegedly faked ICE detention at a hotel
item.summary: A Wisconsin sheriff sues a woman and a local politician over what he calls an "outlandish" lie about being illegally detained in the county jail.
